transcripts.transcript: My name is Robert Allen. I am recording this video to make my wishes clear to my family and trustees. Regarding the lake house in Vermont, I want it to remain in the family. It should not be sold. My daughter Claire and my son David should share equal access and equal responsibility for its upkeep. If they cannot agree, I would like the property placed in a trust managed by my attorney. Regarding my investment portfolio, I want the accounts split equally three ways between Claire, David, and my youngest, Thomas. Thomas is still young, so his share should be held in trust until he turns thirty. The charitable foundation is very important to me. I want ten percent of the estate to go to the foundation each year for five years. My wife Margaret should receive the house in Boston and all personal property. Her comfort and security comes first. Everything else should follow the instructions in the written will. I trust my family to honor these wishes.
